in_marathi.name: Prdip
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sun, Power, Light
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prdip हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pradip is derived from the Sanskrit word pradīpa which means a lamp, light or a source of knowledge and wisdom. The name is associated with the Sun god, signifying power, radiance, and enlightenment.
